title: Pure projection upcaster engine
description: Objective: a dependency-free, side-effect-free engine that upcasts stored events to their current domain schema version and folds them into projection state. SPIDR step 2 of 5, split from task-55d5a898264b4880a99bf2c5b3be120b. Deliverable: pure functions over in-memory values — no SQLite, no transactions, no I/O — so the fold is exhaustively testable without a database. Upcasters dispatch on the StoredEvent domain schema version added in step 1; an unknown or future version fails closed with a stable reason code and never silently passes the event through unmodified. NOT in scope: persistence, the relay/inbox transaction, subscriptions, CURSOR_GAP, or any SQLite access. Hard dependencies: Versioned event schema and projection commit seam (step 1) — needs the StoredEvent schema-version field to dispatch on. Owned paths: packages/store/src/projections/** and its focused tests. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test.
definitionOfDone: Upcasting and projection folding are pure functions over in-memory values with no SQLite, transaction, clock, or filesystem access, demonstrated by tests that construct no database.
An unknown or future domain schema version fails closed with a stable reason code; no event is silently passed through unmodified or dropped.
Folding the same event sequence twice yields identical frozen state, and out-of-order or duplicate input is rejected rather than absorbed.
The focused store typecheck and test command exits 0 and only explicitly owned paths are staged and committed.
taskRails: Purity is the deliverable. Any SQLite handle, transaction, clock read, or filesystem call in this subtree defeats the reason this step was split out.
Fail closed with stable reason codes on unknown versions; missing or unverifiable input stays UNKNOWN and never gains authority.
Use TDD. Keep each production source focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400. Commit by explicit pathspec only.

implementationPlan.description: TDD red — packages/store/src/projections/projection-fold.test.ts (<=250 physical; NO database construction anywhere — purity is the deliverable; assert-the-reason-code rail with mutation red-checks named per refusal). Cases: (1) HAPPY FOLD: foldProjection({checkpoint, state, events, upcaster, reducers}) over in-memory StoredEvent values — returns frozen {checkpoint', state'} with recursive plain-data state (no class instances, no functions); same input twice -> deep-equal frozen results (determinism, fixed fixtures); (2) PREFLIGHT ORDERING (all refusals BEFORE any reducer runs — assert the offending reducer was never invoked via a call-recording reducer): batch globalPosition strictly increasing and above the supplied checkpoint (at-or-below checkpoint -> stale code; non-increasing within batch -> out-of-order code); eventId uniqueness within batch (dup -> duplicate code); per-aggregate sequence STRICTLY increasing within batch (equal -> DUPLICATE code, lower -> OUT_OF_ORDER code — the correction's exact semantics; midstream start LEGAL: a batch beginning at sequence 7 with no prior context passes preflight); (3) UPCAST DISPATCH: every event runs through the supplied StoredEventUpcaster BEFORE its reducer; an unknown/future domainSchemaVersion surfaces the child's SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED outcome as a fold failure (layer-tagged: upcast layer, not fold layer) — the event is NEVER silently passed through unmodified (mutation red-check: bypass the upcaster in a scratch copy, the version test must go red) and NEVER dropped (failure aborts the fold); (4) NO PARTIAL STATE: a reducer throw or upcast failure mid-batch returns a frozen failure carrying the UNCHANGED input state + checkpoint (deep-equal to inputs; nothing folded from the failing batch survives); (5) reducer results deep-frozen + detached (mutating a reducer's returned object post-fold does not alter engine state); (6) hostile inputs (proxy/accessor/extra-key events) refused at preflight with the input-layer code. Confirm RED via `pnpm exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/store/src/projections/projection-fold.test.ts`.
implementationPlan.note: TDD RED landed: packages/store/src/projections/projection-fold.test.ts, 249 physical lines (cap 250). `pnpm exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/store/src/projections/projection-fold.test.ts` -> "Test Files 1 failed (1) / Tests no tests" — the failure is `Failed to load url ./projection-fold.js`, i.e. red because the engine does not exist yet, not because of a typo. NO database is constructed anywhere in the file (no DatabaseSync, no sqlite import). 21 assertions-of-record across 19 tests, each naming the exact stable reason code AND the refusing layer: (1) happy fold -> frozen {checkpoint,state}, nested array frozen, checkpoint advances to the last globalPosition; (2) determinism -> two folds of the same batch deep-equal; (3) empty batch is a legal no-op; (4) PROJECTION_FOLD_STALE_POSITION at AND below the checkpoint; (5) PROJECTION_FOLD_OUT_OF_ORDER on non-increasing globalPosition; (6) PROJECTION_FOLD_DUPLICATE_EVENT on repeated eventId; (7) PROJECTION_FOLD_DUPLICATE_EVENT on EQUAL per-aggregate sequence carried by a DIFFERENT eventId (the correction's exact case); (8) PROJECTION_FOLD_OUT_OF_ORDER on a lower sequence with goal-1/goal-2 INTERLEAVED while globalPosition still strictly increases (the ordering red-team case); (9) midstream start legal — sequences 7 then 9, positions 40n/44n, gaps in both, no contiguity and no sequence-1 requirement; (10) upcast-before-reduce proven by VALUE not by spying: the v1->v2 handler adds 10 to payload[0], so the folded total is 11 and versions is ["v2"] — bypassing the upcaster yields 1/["v1"] and reddens it; (11) unsupported version -> code PROJECTION_FOLD_UPCAST_REFUSED, layer "UPCAST", upcast.code "SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED", upcast.fromVersion "v9"; (12) no partial state — the same test asserts seen === ["evt-1"] (event 1 WAS reduced) yet the returned state deep-equals the input START and the checkpoint stays 5n; (13) reducer throw mid-batch -> PROJECTION_FOLD_REDUCER_FAILED layer REDUCER with unchanged frozen state; (14) non-plain reducer result -> PROJECTION_FOLD_STATE_INVALID; (15) DETACHMENT — the reducer returns a captured object, the test mutates it after the fold (total=99, versions.push) and the folded state is unchanged, so freeze alone cannot pass, only a deep clone; (16) missing reducer -> PROJECTION_FOLD_REDUCER_MISSING (an event is never silently dropped); (17) eventType "constructor" with an empty reducers map must ALSO be REDUCER_MISSING — a prototype-chain lookup would call Object's constructor instead; (18) hostile shapes table (accessor property / unknown extra key / Proxy whose ownKeys trap THROWS) all -> PROJECTION_FOLD_INPUT_INVALID layer INPUT with zero reducer calls, and the table's key list is itself asserted so a silently emptied case list cannot pass; (19) purity guard greps the production source for node:/DatabaseSync/readFile/writeFile/"Date."/Math.random/require(/process. and asserts the module-specifier list is exactly ["../store-contracts.js","./projection-upcast.js"]. Every preflight refusal asserts the recording reducer was never invoked, which is how "refusals precede reduction" is proven rather than assumed.

implementationPlan.description: Green — packages/store/src/projections/projection-fold.ts (target ~155 lines per the sibling sizing, <=250 HARD) + projection-fold.js (exactly `export * from "./projection-fold.ts";` — store subtree keeps committed bridges). Pure function shape: foldProjection(input: {checkpoint: {globalPosition: bigint|string per StoredEvent convention}, state: PlainProjectionState, events: readonly StoredEvent[], upcaster: StoredEventUpcaster, reducers: Readonly<Record<eventType, ProjectionReducer>>}) -> frozen {ok:true, checkpoint, state} | {ok:false, code, detail, checkpoint: input, state: input}; preflight pass FIRST over the whole batch (ordering/uniqueness/sequence rules), then per-event upcast->reduce with fail-closed abort; fold-layer issue codes as frozen local union (PROJECTION_FOLD_* — distinct from the upcast layer's codes so the which-layer assertion holds); no imports beyond './projection-upcast.js', '../store-contracts.js' (StoredEvent type), and store-internals validation helpers if needed — ZERO node: imports (no sqlite/fs/crypto/clock — purity rail; grep-enforced); no Date/random. All step-2 tests green; typecheck green.
implementationPlan.note: GREEN. projection-fold.ts 250 physical (cap 250), projection-fold.js exactly `export * from "./projection-fold.ts";` (1 line). `pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test` -> exit 0, 24 files / 184 tests (baseline was 23/165; this task adds 1 file / 19 tests, zero regressions). Shape: foldProjection({checkpoint:{globalPosition:bigint}, events, reducers, state, upcaster}) -> frozen ProjectionFolded {ok:true, checkpoint, state} | frozen ProjectionFoldRefusal {ok:false, code, layer, detail, eventId, upcast, checkpoint, state}. Design decisions worth QA attention: (1) PREFLIGHT RUNS OVER THE WHOLE BATCH FIRST — every ordering rule is settled before reduceAll is entered, so a refused batch provably never folded its leading events; (2) the fold-layer codes are a local union PROJECTION_FOLD_* and are deliberately DISJOINT from the child's UpcastFailureCode, and the refusal additionally carries layer:"INPUT"|"REDUCER"|"UPCAST" plus the child's verbatim UpcastFailure in `upcast`, so a test can assert WHICH layer refused, not merely that something did; (3) every failure echoes `start` — the cloned INPUT state — never the partially folded accumulator, which is what makes no-partial-state structural rather than incidental; (4) normalizeEvent REBUILDS each event from values captured through Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor, so an accessor is refused rather than invoked and a proxy gets exactly one chance to answer — the reducer and the upcaster then see the validated copy, never the caller's object; byte fields are re-wrapped with `new Uint8Array(value)` (never .slice(), which would share the ArrayBuffer per the sibling's finding); (5) plainClone deep-copies AND freezes, refusing class instances, functions, symbol keys, array holes, extra array properties, and cycles (path Set) — the clone is what gives detachment, freezing alone would not; (6) the reducer lookup uses Object.hasOwn, so eventType "constructor"/"__proto__" cannot resolve to an inherited function and get invoked; (7) reducer invocation and the plainness inspection of its result sit INSIDE THE SAME try, per mem:gotcha-output-inspection-outside-the-trycatch — a hostile getter on the returned object cannot escape as a throw; the upcaster call is likewise guarded even though its contract says it never throws; (8) an unregistered eventType is PROJECTION_FOLD_REDUCER_MISSING, not a silent skip — a projection that ignores a type must register an identity reducer, so no event is ever silently dropped. Purity holds: exactly two module specifiers, "../store-contracts.js" and "./projection-upcast.js"; zero node: imports; no clock, no randomness, no filesystem, no SQLite. One typecheck defect was caught and fixed here rather than shipped: upcastOne originally returned UpcastOutcome|Issue and `!("ok" in outcome)` does NOT narrow to the ok:true arm, so `outcome.event` failed TS2339 — note that vitest was GREEN with that error because vitest does not typecheck. It now returns StoredEvent|Issue and the caller discriminates on "code" in current, which narrows correctly because StoredEvent has no `code` field.

(2) FRESH GATE post-commit: `pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test` -> EXIT 0, 24 files / 184 tests (baseline 23/165). (3) PURITY GREP RUN AGAINST HEAD CONTENT: `git show HEAD:...projection-fold.ts | grep "node:\|DatabaseSync\|readFile\|writeFile\|Date\.\|Math\.random"` -> zero hits; module specifiers are exactly ["../store-contracts.js","./projection-upcast.js"]; the test's only "DatabaseSync" occurrence is the forbidden-token list itself — no database is constructed anywhere in the suite. (4) EIGHT MUTATION RED-CHECKS, out-of-tree backup per mem:gotcha-mutation-testing-restore-safety (the file is untracked, so `git checkout` could not have restored it), each restore verified by git hash-object — final hash identical to baseline, no RESTORE MISMATCH. Bypass upcaster -> 2 red (upcast-before-reduce + version refusal). Disable the position check -> out-of-order red. Echo the partial accumulator instead of the input state -> no-partial-state red. Return the source instead of a frozen clone -> 3 red (freeze + unchanged-state + detachment). Allow equal per-aggregate sequence -> the correction's duplicate case red. Prototype-chain reducer lookup instead of Object.hasOwn -> the "constructor" test red. (5) ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW FOUND AND FIXED TWO REAL DEFECTS THE GREEN SUITE DID NOT SEE — both verified at the JS level before fixing, then mutation-verified after: (a) `FIELD_KINDS[key] === undefined` is FALSE for key "__proto__" and "constructor" because the lookup walks the prototype chain, so the extra-key guard waved both through; an event with an own "constructor" key normalized successfully, and an own "__proto__" key gave the normalized event an ATTACKER-CONTROLLED PROTOTYPE. Fixed with Object.hasOwn(FIELD_KINDS, key). (b) In plainClone, `draft["__proto__"] = item` invokes the Object.prototype setter — it swaps the prototype instead of creating an own key, so a state key named "__proto__" was SILENTLY ABSORBED (key lost, prototype replaced). Fixed by refusing "__proto__" keys outright. The first fix went red immediately; THE SECOND DID NOT — mutating it away left all 19 tests green, because the event-shaped hostile fixture is caught by (a) first and never reaches plainClone. That is mem:gotcha-mutation-finds-the-untested-half-of-a-pair exactly: I added the reachable case (an input STATE carrying a "__proto__" key, not an event) and re-ran, and only then did the guard go red. (6) ORDERING RED-TEAM both covered and mutation-proven: a batch that is globalPosition-ordered but per-aggregate out-of-order via goal-1/goal-2 interleaving refuses with PROJECTION_FOLD_OUT_OF_ORDER, and equal sequence across DIFFERENT eventIds refuses with PROJECTION_FOLD_DUPLICATE_EVENT. (7) REPO-WIDE DIRECTORY-WALKING GUARDS RUN, not just grepped — scheduler package-boundary, testkit, skills: 21 files / 323 passed, 1 skipped. A grep proves the file text is clean; running them proves the new directory shape is too. (8) NO SCRATCH FILES: the mutation harness and commit message lived in /tmp, outside the repository, and were deleted. (9) COMMIT per epic rail 3: index was empty before staging; `git add` + `git commit -F <msgfile> --` with the three explicit pathspecs; `git show --stat` lists EXACTLY packages/store/src/projections/projection-fold.{js,test.ts,ts}, 501 insertions. Foreign in-flight work (apps/control-room/src/attempts/, apps/control-room/src/nodes/, .moe/** daemon metadata) was left untouched and unstaged. THEORETICAL, NOT FIXED, FLAGGED FOR QA: `events` is typed readonly StoredEvent[] but consumed with for-of, so a caller passing an INFINITE generator would hang rather than refuse; every other malformed-batch shape (null, non-iterable, throwing iterator) is already caught by the entry try and refused INPUT_INVALID. Deep recursion in plainClone is contained — a RangeError from a pathologically nested state is caught by the same try and fails closed as INPUT_INVALID or REDUCER_FAILED rather than escaping.
